name: Reflective Barrier
description: When the creature is attack by a spell or other magical effect, it can use its reaction to reflect the spell back at the caster, requiring the caster to make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the caster takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
